latest.summary: 27 submissions reviewed for the Central calendar day of Sunday 10/04/2026: 7 H2S Safety Supervision Daily Inspection Forms, 6 Trailer Inspection Forms, 2 Trailer Readiness Forms, 6 air job / OWL forms, 2 field service job summaries, 2 supervision job summaries, 1 EIR inspections job summary, and 1 H2S Equipment Rig Up

concerns.title: Jordan Lemmons and 1099 Cindy Smith — XTO — TXL 27 4 BTA 1077 1077JH — 01:52 PM to 04:04 PM — job IDs 35350 and 35351. Both technicians recorded 21 ppm H2S on the pre-tes

concerns.title: 1099 Cindy Smith — XTO — DRIVER E5A 101H — 09:14 AM to 01:39 PM — job ID 35375. A near miss was recorded, along with an LEL overload on the pre-test and benzene detected
concerns.text: "Work area and bleeder valves tested prior to crew beginning work. There was overload on LEL on pretest. Crew had to use hand tools only. doc.text: Bottle Hydro Dates and cascade pressures

Clean and complete on four H2S dailies: Dennis Easley, trailer 103 — "4@ 2200 psi" / "4@ 3/23". Michael Ellis, trailer 272 — "2400" / "05/24". Bobby Fleming, trailer 151 — "6@3300" / "8/27x4 7/27x1 3/28x1". Justin Pack, trailer 506 — "5@2400&1@700" / "6@7/23".

Clean and complete on both Trailer Readiness Forms. Trailer 606 (Lemmons): bottles 1 to 4 read "7/25-4000", "7/25-4500", "7/25-4500", "7/25-4500" — each carries both a pressure and a hydro date. Trailer 602 (Flores): bottles 1 to 4 read "4500 07/25" on all four. Bottles 5 to 10 read "O" on 606 and "N/A" on 602, meaning those positions are empty; neither is a finding.

Worth confirming, not a defect: Joshua Blassingame, trailer 506 — "Bottle Hydro Dates" reads "7-23" but "Pressure on Cascade System" reads "All bottles full" rather than a pressure reading. The field is not blank, so this is not a missing entry, but a narrative in place of a number is harder to audit than the numeric entries his colleagues used on the same trailer.

Exempt because the board AT# is exactly "N/A": Larry Taylor (Comstock EIR, multiple locations) and 1099 Gage Gonzales (SM Energy Seinfeld Fed Unit 521H) both left Bottle Hydro Dates and Pressure on Cascade System blank. There is no air trailer on either job, so those fields are expected to be empty and the blank air-trailer photo sections on Gonzales's form are expected too. Neither is a finding.
Photos not taken on the day being verified

1099 Gage Gonzales — H2S daily, SM Energy Seinfeld Fed Unit, submitted 10/04/2026 05:18 AM. Every single photo on the form is dated 10/03/2026 — not one was taken on 10/04. That covers the 4-gas and single-gas photos, SCBA and SABA checklists, pressure gauges, masks, ELSA, muster stand, monitor, all four sensor placement and faceplate photos, loud alarm position, windsock and condition sign. This is the most significant photo finding of the day.
Michael Ellis — H2S daily, Diamondback Tyler 3709. ELSA Photos and Loud Alarm Position Photos both dated 08/02/2021 10:20 AM, over five years old. All other photos are from 10/04.
Dennis Easley — H2S daily, Comstock Kern 1H. ELSA Photos and Loud Alarm Position Photos both dated 12/28/2025 04:45 PM. All other photos are from 10/04.

Bobby Fleming — H2S daily, SM Energy Coonskin Fee 112H. ELSA Photos and the single gas / 4 gas without pump photo both dated 03/11/2025 01:51 PM. This is a repeat: Fleming was flagged for reusing a 03/11/2025 ELSA photo set on 09/26/2026, on both of his dailies that day. It is the same date stamp again. His Loud Alarm Position photo today was current (10/04 03:18 PM), so this is narrowing rather than widening.
1099 Rolando Flores — Trailer Readiness Form, trailer 602. Cascade Low Pressure Alarm and AV-3000 masks photos both dated 10/25/2024 02:54 PM, nearly a year old.
Jordan Lemmons — Trailer Readiness Form, trailer 606. Cascade Low Pressure Alarm photo dated 05/01/2026 11:46 AM. All other photos on the form are from 10/04 between 05:11 PM and 05:15 PM.

Stefanie Kirschke — H2S Equipment Rig Up Rig Check Photos Form, H&P 379 Terlingua. ELSA Pressure Gauge photo dated 10/21/2025 11:23 AM. The other roughly forty photos on the form are all from 10/04 between 06:10 AM and 07:12 AM.
Larry Jaramillo — field service 35425_1, Junior Mint. The JSA photo, the only photo on the form, is dated 09/09/2026 12:48 PM, about 25 days before the job.

Larry Taylor — EIR job 34802_1. Three JSA photos are back-dated relative to the daily entries they are attached to (the 09/22 entry carries a 09/21 photo; the 09/24 and 09/26 entries both carry the same 09/23 photo). Minor, and within a two-week job, but the same JSA appearing on two separate days is worth a word.

Stale ELSA and Loud Alarm Position photos on the H2S daily remain the most persistent documentation problem — four of the seven dailies filed today carry at least one, and three of those four are the ELSA photo specifically.
Blank OWL close-out

1099 Cindy Smith, job 35351, TXL 27 4 BTA 1077 1077JH. The entire L — Learn section is blank: "One thing we'll do better next time", "Did we leave the location better than we found it?" and "How did we leave this location better than we found it?" are all empty. This matters more than usual here because it is the form covering the 21 ppm reading and the leaking valve — the close-out is where that lesson would be captured.
1099 Cindy Smith, job 35375, DRIVER E5A 101H. "How did we leave this location better than we found it?" left blank; the other two Learn fields were completed.
Empty multi-selects
None today. Every "What did we observe?" and "What went well?" multi-select on all six air job forms had at least one item chosen.
Data in the wrong field
Jordan Lemmons, job 35350 — OWL "Location Name" entered as "Txl 27 4 bra" against a well of TXL 27 4 BTA 1077 1077JH.
1099 Cindy Smith, job 35375 — OWL "Location Name" entered as "Driver ESA 101H" against a well of DRIVER E5A 101H (letter S for the numeral 5).
1099 Cindy Smith, Trailer Inspection Form 03:37 PM — the single-name "H2S Safety Technician Name" field holds two names, "Cindy, Jordan".
No "Enter Notes..." placeholders were found in any of the 27 forms, and no well name appeared in an "Employee Name(s)" field.
Records that do not match the work

Customer name inconsistent on both Junior Mint field service forms. Jaramillo's 35425_1 and Jobe's 35425_2 both carry a "Customer Name" of "Ovintiv", while the board, the email subject and the "Bill to Company" field on both forms all say SM Energy, ticket 102044. Because it appears identically on both forms it looks more like a template default than two independent typing errors, but it should be confirmed before these go out — a customer name is the sort of field that follows a ticket into billing.

Air job 35427_1 (Bailey) records a job total of $0.01 and a blank tube count, while its companion 35427_2 (Flores) on the same well and ticket records $0.00 and one tube. The cent is almost certainly a stray keystroke; flagging it only because it is on a billable ticket.

Not a discrepancy, so nobody should chase it: trailer 606 appears at the Andrews shop at 07:41 AM, at E County Rd 300 in Midland at 03:37 PM, and back at the Andrews shop at 05:20 PM. That sequence tracks the crew's movement between the two XTO jobs and back, and is consistent across all three forms. Trailer 602 shows the same pattern.
Comments to management other than N/A

Only one: Jordan Lemmons's trailer 606 readiness form, "Jack could be replaced it doesn't want to corporate", covered as concern 3 above. The readiness form has no "Comments or Concerns for Management" field; this is its equivalent, "Is anything wrong or missing? If so what and who was notified?", and no notified party is named.
All six Trailer Inspection Forms and all seven H2S dailies recorded "N/A" in "Comments or Concerns for Management". Flores's trailer 602 readiness form left the equivalent field blank.

Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review — I can read the capture timestamp and the caption, but not the image. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates, SCBA and workpack inspection sheet dates, and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside those images and not as text, so none of them were verified today.

A second limitation specific to tonight: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central, so the usual follow-up search of the next morning's mailbox could not be run. Submissions for 10/04 that land after 11:15 PM tonight or tomorrow morning are not included here, and any form reported above as absent should be re-checked against tomorrow's mailbox before anyone is asked about it.

27 of 27 submissions read. Both job boards were available — the 10/4/2026 ArkLaTex and Permian Basin boards sent by Blake Walton at 10:26 AM, the correct day's boards, using the "10-4" sheet in each workbook. 45 manned-work rows were checked across the two boards, of which 19 carried a real assignment; the remainder were days off, PTO, leave, WTX support, or rows marked ON STANDBY.
